summary: Iteration 21 - End-to-end verification of (1) auto-publish toggle, (2) remix history, (3) Kaggle GPU engines/admin, (4) worker auth. Backend: 11/12 pytest in test_iter21_features.py pass; one minor: /api/share/{id} omits the `public` key when the doc has no public flag set (projection {'public':1} drops missing fields in Mongo). Frontend: /create shows auto-publish-toggle (role=switch), toggles with toast 'Auto-publish on: new images go straight to the public gallery', persists after reload, hidden when logged out. /create?gen=<edit2> shows result-image + remix-history strip with testid 'remix-history-count' reading '3 versions' and 3 remix-history-item entries; current one has aria-current=step; clicking step-1 reveals compare-btn; result-publish-btn reads 'Public' with aria-pressed=true for the published seed edit. Mobile 390px /create still shows toggle + full history strip. /gallery: 9 gallery-publish-{id} testids, 4 gallery-history-{id}, 1 gallery-public-badge-{id}. /video: 3s/4s chips present, video-eta text 'Takes about 4 min on a free GPU (plus 6-10 min if it has to wake up) to render.' /status as admin: kaggle-panel, kaggle-status ('Kaggle session: complete · GPU worker stopped - No jobs for 20 min'), kaggle-launch-btn, kaggle-stop-btn, kaggle-open-link all present. Per instructions NO real-video job was launched (quota) and Start/Stop in /status were NOT pressed. Backend engine check: frasberg-motion-free has on_demand=true, status='on-demand' (worker idle). Admin /gpu-admin/kaggle returns configured=true, username='frasberg', boot present; /gpu-admin/overview includes boot. Worker /boot and /offline both reject requests without X-Frasberg-Worker-Secret with 401.

minor.issue: Response is missing `public` key when the generation document has no `public` field set. The projection `{"public":1}` with motor only returns the key if it exists in the doc. Spec says /share must also return parent_id/root_id/step/public. Fix: default `doc.setdefault('public', False)` before returning (same pattern already used in remix_history).

action_items: Fix /api/share/{gen_id} to always include `public` (default False) when the field is absent in the document.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L747-754 share(): Mongo projection drops missing fields; the response contract advertises `public` but it will be absent for docs created before auto-publish feature. Add `doc.setdefault('public', False)` similar to remix_history L726.

server.py L326-344 resolve_parent(): correctly inserts a hidden step-0 'source' doc for first-time edits and increments step for parented edits; verified via test_two_edits_produce_chain (step 1 then step 2 with same root_id).

server.py L318-323 wants_publish(): guests never publish, user default follows auto_publish, per-request `publish` body overrides. Explicit `publish: false` while auto_publish is on correctly produces a private generation (verified).
frasberg_gpu.py L227-239 /v1/engines: when on_demand model has 0 online workers but is in ON_DEMAND, returns status='on-demand' which is what the UI depends on - verified.
RemixHistory UI properly emits data-testid remix-history-count and remix-history-item-{id} with aria-current='step' only on the current gen; compare-btn appears when a non-current step is selected.
seed_data_creation: Two draft generations (one auto-published then unpublished, one private via publish:false) plus a 2-step edit chain under test@luchii.ai (prompts prefixed TEST_). No real-video job was submitted (quota preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_features.py. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter21_features.py -n 0`. ~6 min total because each image job is a real CPU render (~45s). The sole failing assertion `TestRemixHistory::test_share_includes_lineage` is a backend bug: /api/share response omits `public` when the doc has no public field (projection quirk). The seeded chain 76b024f6->f6b1f035->2b8f856c is still intact under test@luchii.ai. Do NOT invoke real video or kaggle launch/stop (user's free GPU quota).
rca of the issue: /api/share path returns the Mongo document straight after projection. In Motor, including a field in the projection does NOT force the field to be present on the response - fields that don't exist on the document are simply omitted. Older generations never had `public` set (only published ones get `public: True`). Spec expects `public: false` default. Fix: in share(), after retrieval, do `doc.setdefault('public', False)` and `doc.setdefault('step', 0)` for safety, mirroring the pattern already used in remix_history (L726).
